questions.prompt: The chart shows three other Western Conference seasons. How many regular-season games did Chris Paul's 2007–08 Hornets win?
questions.context: New Orleans · first full season back in the city
questions.note: 56 wins and a Southwest Division title.

funFacts.text: The Hornets returned full-time to New Orleans after two seasons partly in Oklahoma City.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: They returned to New Orleans full-time for the first time since 2004–05

funFacts.text: Byron Scott coached the franchise through its resurgence.

questions.prompt: Stephen Curry's then-record 13 threes in a game came in 2016. How many threes did Orlando make as a team against Sacramento in January 2009?
questions.note: 23 made threes in a high-scoring win.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Magic scored an NBA record 23 three-pointers against the Sacramento Kings

funFacts.text: Nine different Orlando players made at least one three-pointer that night.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Nine of the twelve Magic players who played that night scored at least one three pointer

funFacts.text: Jameer Nelson hit five threes and JJ Redick added four.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jameer Nelson (5), JJ Redick (4), Keith Bogans (4)

funFacts.text: The Magic won the game 139–107 in Sacramento.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: January 13 @ Sacramento W 139–107

questions.prompt: In February 2003, Kobe Bryant scored 40 or more in how many consecutive games?
questions.note: Nine straight, averaging 40.6 for the month.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: posting 40 or more points in nine consecutive games while averaging 40.6 in February

funFacts.text: Kobe averaged an astonishing 40.6 points per game during that February.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: while averaging 40.6 in February

funFacts.text: He also posted career-best averages of 6.9 rebounds and 5.9 assists during the season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He also averaged career-high 6.9 rebounds, 5.9 assists, and 2.2 steals

funFacts.text: The Lakers' attempt at another title ended against the eventual champion San Antonio Spurs.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: lost in the semifinals in six games to the eventual champions San Antonio Spurs

questions.prompt: In Chris Paul's astonishing 2022 perfect-shooting playoff clincher, how many field goals did he make without a miss?
questions.context: Chris Paul · Suns at Pelicans · 2022 playoffs
questions.note: 14-for-14. Paul did not miss a single field goal in the playoff closeout.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Chris Paul scored 33 points on a perfect 14-for-14 from the field (including one three-pointer)

funFacts.text: His perfect shooting included one three-pointer.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)

funFacts.text: He also did not miss at the free-throw line.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)

funFacts.text: Booker returned from injury for the clincher.
